summary.text: Kyle Davison is a Republican state senator from North Dakota who has represented District 41 since December 2014 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Davison assumed office in the North Dakota State Senate on December 1, 2014, succeeding Tony Grindberg.
Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the Senate Government and Veterans Affairs Committee in the 2019-2020 session and as a member of the Senate Education Committee that session.
For 2023-2024 it lists him on the Appropriations Human Resources Division.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026.
